7th Annual All Black Attire Party + Men’s Fashion Show @ MartinPatrick3

Wed, Sep 18, 2024 · 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM · MartinPatrick3

When
Wed, Sep 18, 2024 · 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM
Where
MartinPatrick3
212 3rd Ave N Ste 106, Minneapolis, MN
Cost

More: All Black Attire Party

Join MARTINPATRICK3 X IAMMOODY for the most anticipated Fall fashion event in Minneapolis. The 7th Annual All-Black Attire Party in the alley returns!  Minneapolis fashion show and Runway producer Richard Moody architects a new experience for the best men’s fashion and Minnesota’s top male models at the Twin Cities best place to find style.

  1. Watch Minnesota’s top male models of all ages, ethnicities, and orientations walk the runway, showcasing the best fall fashions available at MartinPatrick3.
  2. Come dressed in your favorite black attire to party before, during, and after.
  3. Mix, mingle, and shop.
  4. Cash cocktail bar
  5. Listen to funky beats by DJ Cousin Christopher
  6. 😎 Tickets required

Grab your FREE ticket as an RSVP on Eventbrite.
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/891129300727
